name: Upload Post
description: Publish to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Threads, Pinterest, Reddit, Bluesky and Snapchat. Long-form video, short clips, photos, carousels, text, threads, documents and link previews. Schedule cross-platform, repurpose long videos into viral shorts with AI, build Instagram comment-to-DM funnels (AutoDMs), and track analytics. Backed by the Upload-Post MCP server (40+ tools) plus six opinionated skills and three subagents for content strategy, autodm architecture, and upload debugging. Free plan, no credit card required
longDescription:
Ships **8 skills**, **3 agents** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (8): `analyze-performance` (Pull analytics from Upload-Post (account-level and post-level), summarise what is working, and suggest content moves), `autodm-setup` (Set up an Instagram comment-to-DM funnel), `manage-comments` (Read and reply to comments on published posts across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and LinkedIn, and reply to Google…), `posting-queue` (Configure and inspect the Upload-Post posting queue — the recurring time slots that queued content drips into), `repurpose-video` (Turn a long video (talking head, podcast, livestream, webinar) into multiple viral short clips and schedule them to…), `schedule-campaign` (Schedule a post (text, photo, video, or thread) across multiple platforms at once), `setup` (Onboard a new Upload-Post user), `whitelabel-connect` (Generate a JWT-authenticated connection URL so a client or end-user can OAuth their social accounts into a profile…)
- **Agents** (3): `autodm-architect` (Designs Instagram comment-to-DM funnels end-to-end — picks the trigger keyword, writes the public reply, drafts the DM body…), `content-strategist` (Analyses Upload-Post account performance and recommends concrete next posts), `post-debugger` (Diagnoses failed Upload-Post uploads, expired social tokens, scheduling errors, and AutoDM monitor failures)
- **MCP servers** (1): `upload-post`

Installs with `claude plugin install upload-post@claude-community` from `mutonby/upload-post-plugin`.
